title: Physical activity for adults and older adults
text: Regular physical activity supports health and functional ability. The exact amount and type should be adapted to the person's abilities and circumstances.

title: General hydration education
text: Fluid needs vary by person and situation. General hydration information is educational and is not a substitute for individual medical advice.

title: Falls prevention overview
text: Falls are an important public-health issue. Prevention can involve attention to environmental hazards, physical function, and other risk factors.
